_doc: California hospital muni obligor universe for CA-focused detector framework test
_methodology: Compiled from web research May 2026; sources: Moody's/S&P/Fitch press, Becker's Hospital Review, Bond Buyer, CHFFA staff reports, CSCDA disclosures, hospital IR pages. Ratings as of most recent published action 2024-2026; some carry forward older affirmations where no 2024+ action found. Revenue figures approximate, drawn from hospital IR/Form 990 where available.
_caveats: Where a rating field is null = no public rating from that agency (some issuers pay for only 1-2 agencies). UNVERIFIABLE = rating exists but specific notch could not be confirmed within search budget. CA hospitals are broadly affected by HCAI SB 1953 seismic compliance (2030 deadline extension under SB 1432).

obligors.name: Adventist Health
obligors.notes: Fitch downgraded to BBB+ from A in 2024 on Tenet hospitals acquisition (~$750M new debt). 28-hospital system across CA/OR/WA/HI.

obligors.name: Loma Linda University Medical Center
obligors.conduit_issuer: California Public Finance Authority / California Municipal Finance Authority
obligors.notes: Sub-IG. Fitch downgraded to BB. Largest seismic-driven capital project in CA ($1.2B Campus Transformation). Material distress test case.

obligors.name: Lompoc Valley Medical Center
obligors.notes: Moody's downgraded from A3 to Baa1 in late 2025 on liquidity narrowing from cap-ex self-funding. Small district hospital.

obligors.name: Children's Hospital Los Angeles
obligors.notes: Sub-IG. Moody's downgraded twice in 2025 (Baa3 -> Ba1 -> Ba2). S&P lowered to BB+ Feb 2025 then withdrew Oct 2025. Heavy Medi-Cal exposure. Critical distress test case.

obligors.name: Eisenhower Medical Center
obligors.notes: Outlook upgraded to positive by Moody's; Fitch upgraded to BBB from BBB- in 2024 on improved EBITDA.

obligors.name: Cedars-Sinai Health System
obligors.legal_obligor_name: Cedars-Sinai Health System (Obligated Group incl. CSMC, CS Marina, Torrance Memorial, Huntington)
obligors.notes: Fitch affirmed AA- Nov 2025. Obligated group materially expanded post Torrance Memorial (2018) and Huntington (2024) integrations.

obligors.name: Stanford Health Care
obligors.notes: Moody's Aa2 affirmed May 2024. SHC operates a commercial paper program (only CHFFA borrower doing so). Gross receivables pledge.

obligors.name: Sutter Health
obligors.notes: Includes CPMC (San Francisco) and ~24 affiliated hospitals across Northern CA. Antitrust settlement history (UFCW case).

obligors.name: Kaiser Foundation Hospitals
obligors.conduit_issuer: California Health Facilities Financing Authority (multiple historical conduits)
obligors.notes: Consolidated 2024 revenue $115.8B (KFHP+KFH+Risant combined). Moody's rating notch UNVERIFIABLE precisely but historically Aa3/A1 range; Fitch AA- with stable outlook. Treat as one obligor per scope spec.

obligors.name: University of California Medical Centers (UCLA/UCSF/UCSD/UCI/UCD pooled)
obligors.legal_obligor_name: The Regents of the University of California - Medical Center Pooled Revenue Bonds
obligors.conduit_issuer: The Regents of the University of California (direct issuer, not conduit)
obligors.notes: Pooled obligation - the 5 academic medical centers (UCLA, UCSF, UCSD, UC Irvine, UC Davis) share a single revenue pledge. NOT a CHFFA conduit; issued directly by UC Regents. Each center is also a separate operating entity but bondholders look at pooled revenue.

obligors.name: Lucile Salter Packard Children's Hospital at Stanford
obligors.legal_obligor_name: Lucile Salter Packard Children's Hospital at Stanford
obligors.notes: CHFFA 2024A $204M direct purchase by Morgan Stanley. Separate obligated group from Stanford Health Care. Specific Moody's notch UNVERIFIABLE - previously A1, may have been downgraded; needs EMMA confirmation.

obligors.name: Sharp HealthCare
obligors.notes: $343M fixed-rate bond deal early 2024. Aa3 Moody's. 300+ days cash on hand. Industry-wide headwinds noted for 2024.

obligors.name: Scripps Health
obligors.notes: Moody's withdrew Aa3 in Oct 2022 'for lack of sufficient information' then reaffirmed. S&P/Fitch AA stable. ~$2B in CHFFA debt outstanding.

obligors.name: Hoag Memorial Hospital Presbyterian
obligors.notes: Independent since 2020 Providence split. Fitch AA stable. Strong OC market position.

obligors.name: MemorialCare Health System
obligors.notes: Fitch downgraded to A+ from AA- in 2024. Operates Long Beach Memorial, Miller Children's, Orange Coast, Saddleback.

obligors.name: Providence Health & Services (California operations)
obligors.city_county: Renton WA HQ / Irvine CA secondary
obligors.notes: Moody's affirmed A2 May 2024, outlook negative. St. Joseph Health (California) rolled into Providence credit Oct 2016. Operates 17+ CA hospitals.

obligors.name: CommonSpirit Health (incl. Dignity Health CA hospitals)
obligors.conduit_issuer: California Health Facilities Financing Authority (Dignity legacy)
obligors.notes: Moody's upgraded Dignity-legacy parity debt to A3 from Baa1 in Feb 2024. 33 CA acute care hospitals via Dignity Health subsidiary. ~$18.4B total debt.

obligors.name: John Muir Health
obligors.notes: Moody's A1 affirmed. ~$390M rated debt. East Bay system.

obligors.name: El Camino Health
obligors.notes: Fitch upgraded to AA from AA- in 2024 on operating profile. Note: separate from El Camino Healthcare District (taxing authority) which has GO bonds.

obligors.name: Cottage Health
obligors.notes: S&P AA- affirmed Nov 2025. Operates Santa Barbara Cottage, Goleta Valley Cottage, Santa Ynez Valley Cottage.

obligors.name: City of Hope
obligors.notes: Moody's downgraded to A2 from A1 in 2022 on CTCA acquisition. ~$2B+ long-term debt outstanding.

obligors.name: Kaweah Health (Kaweah Delta Health Care District)
obligors.notes: Sub-IG. Moody's Ba1 affirmed Feb 2024, outlook stable. $220M rated debt. Received $20.8M from Distressed Hospital Loan Program. Only hospital in Visalia.

obligors.name: Palomar Health
obligors.conduit_issuer: California Health Facilities Financing Authority / direct GO district
obligors.notes: Deep distress. Moody's revenue Caa1 (Feb 2025 from B2), GO Ba1. Fitch B- on JPA progress. CA's largest public hospital district. Critical sub-IG test case.

obligors.name: MarinHealth Medical Center
obligors.legal_obligor_name: Marin Healthcare District (split: hospital revenue obligor + district GO)
obligors.notes: Fitch BBB revenue / AA- GO district. Outlook revised positive Oct 2024. Note bifurcated capital structure.

obligors.name: Antelope Valley Healthcare District
obligors.notes: Sub-IG. Moody's Ba3 affirmed; some indication rating later withdrawn. $126M rated debt. 420-bed Antelope Valley Hospital. Management turnover, labor issues.

obligors.name: Tri-City Healthcare District
obligors.conduit_issuer: Direct issuer (district GO) / California Municipal Finance Authority
obligors.notes: Public hospital district. $596M GO bond measure placed 2024. Historical low-IG/sub-IG ratings; current notch UNVERIFIABLE.

obligors.name: Washington Township Health Care District
obligors.conduit_issuer: Direct issuer (district GO) / California Municipal Finance Authority
obligors.notes: Parent of Washington Hospital Healthcare System. Public hospital district. Ratings UNVERIFIABLE in current search.

obligors.name: Alameda Health System
obligors.notes: Public safety-net system. Alameda County hospital authority. Historically distressed; rating data limited.

obligors.name: Rady Children's Hospital - San Diego
obligors.legal_obligor_name: Rady Children's Hospital and Health Center
obligors.notes: Aa3 Moody's, AA Fitch. $366M rated debt. Acquired CHOC in 2024 affiliation.

obligors.name: Children's Hospital of Orange County (CHOC)
obligors.notes: Affiliated with Rady Children's Health 2024. Separate obligor for now.

obligors.name: Valley Children's Healthcare
obligors.notes: Moody's A1 affirmed (2018 latest action found). $202.5M 2018A bonds. Central Valley children's hospital.

obligors.name: PIH Health
obligors.notes: S&P A on 2024A/B bonds. PIH Health Whittier, Downey, Good Samaritan (acquired from LA Times Mirror legacy).

obligors.name: Enloe Health (Enloe Medical Center)
obligors.notes: CSCDA $380M 2022 issuance. S&P AA- historical; 2024 not confirmed. Northern CA, sole community hospital.

obligors.name: Pomona Valley Hospital Medical Center
obligors.notes: S&P BBB (2015 last action found). Current rating UNVERIFIABLE - flagged for 2025+ refresh. Independent community hospital.

obligors.name: Huntington Hospital
obligors.notes: Affiliated with Cedars-Sinai (joined obligated group ~2024). May still have legacy standalone CUSIPs outstanding under Huntington name.

obligors.name: Verity Health System (defunct)
obligors.legal_obligor_name: Verity Health System of California, Inc.
obligors.conduit_issuer: California Statewide Communities Development Authority / California Public Finance Authority
obligors.notes: Chapter 11 Aug 2018. Seton Medical Center sold to AHMC Healthcare Apr 2020. Daughters of Charity 2005A bonds and Verity 2015 notes through CPFA. Historical distress case - useful for backtesting.

obligors.name: Madera Community Hospital
obligors.notes: Chapter 11 Mar 2023, closed Jan 2023. Reopened May 2024 under American Advanced Management with $57M Distressed Hospital Loan Program. Active distress case.

obligors.name: Watsonville Community Hospital (Pajaro Valley Health Care District)
obligors.notes: Acquired out of bankruptcy by Pajaro Valley Health Care District Aug 2022. Measure N $116M GO bond approved Mar 2024. Public district structure post-acquisition.

obligors.name: NorthBay Health
obligors.notes: $80M CMFA revenue bonds approved Dec 2025 (~$106M YTD). Recent issuer. Ratings UNVERIFIABLE in search. Solano County.
